content:
Set up the folder structure for /var/www/projects/nexifynewweb:

- Create folders: css/, js/, images/, libs/, includes/, pages/
- Copy local libraries from /opt/codehero/libs/:
  * libs/tailwind.js (from /opt/codehero/libs/js/tailwind-v4-cdn.js)
  * libs/alpine.min.js (from /opt/codehero/libs/js/alpine-3.min.js)
  * libs/fontawesome.min.css (from /opt/codehero/libs/css/fontawesome.min.css)
  * webfonts/* (from /opt/codehero/libs/webfonts/)
- Verify file sizes (tailwind ~398KB, alpine ~46KB)
- Create empty includes/header.php and includes/footer.php placeholders
- Do NOT touch any uploaded files at the project root

Do NOT use external CDNs or npm. Use ONLY files copied from /opt/codehero/libs/.
